title: The research facts on splitlines and rebase --abort are anchored with a quote or named unanchored

run:
import subprocess,sys
o=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/factdiff.py','--root','public','anchors','--unlocated'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
